subject: math
description: Judge whether statistical claims are supported by graphs, tables, and summary statistics.
learningObjectives: Identify the claim, data source, sample size, scale, and labels in a statistical display.
Match claims to appropriate displays such as bar graphs, line graphs, tables, and summary statistics.
Use percentages, differences, and summary statistics as evidence for or against a claim.
Explain when a display or wording may exaggerate, understate, or overgeneralize the data.
prerequisites: Read values from tables and simple graphs
Convert fractions and decimals to percents
Compare quantities using differences and percentages
